bundle_summary: Advancing three coherent bachelorette party niche themes: (1) Girls Gone Mild modest/wholesome bachelorette theme, (2) Wine-centric “Vino Before Vows,” and (3) Coastal/destination trips signaled by “Last Toast on the Coast” and Carmel-by-the-Sea. Product-only and broad occasion terms held as ingredients. One brand-term quarantined.
bundle_warnings: Named brand mention detected and quarantined: “comfort colors” (bac19). Broad product and occasion terms were treated as ingredients, not standalone niches.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Brides/bridesmaids planning a modest or low-key bachelorette party
hypotheses.concise_evidence: Two separate searches explicitly for the ‘Girls Gone Mild’ bachelorette theme with measurable clicks and competition suggest active interest.
hypotheses.label: Girls Gone Mild bachelorette theme (modest/wholesome vibe) for apparel and decor
hypotheses.uncertainty: Theme scale beyond Etsy unclear; demand may be seasonal and phrase-specific.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Wine-loving bridal parties planning themed celebrations
hypotheses.concise_evidence: Two distinct queries around ‘Vino Before Vows’ including a banner-specific variant indicate targeted themed demand.
hypotheses.label: Wine-themed “Vino Before Vows” bachelorette party items
hypotheses.theme_identity_or_occasion: Wine-centric bachelorette theme signaled by “Vino Before Vows”
hypotheses.uncertainty: Theme may be phrase-dependent; performance could hinge on exact wording.

hypotheses.concise_evidence: Coastal phrase ‘Last Toast on the Coast’ shows demand, reinforced by location-specific ‘Carmel by the Sea bachelorette’.
hypotheses.label: Coastal/destination bachelorette trips (“Last Toast on the Coast”, Carmel-by-the-Sea)
hypotheses.uncertainty: Demand may cluster around a few coastal phrases/locations and be regionally concentrated.
